evidence.quoted_text: completed = sum(day.get("completed_partitions", 0) for day in observed.values())
evidence.reason: The capacity estimate mixes populations: line 175 counts only T1 candidates as remaining work, while line 174 sums the generic `completed_partitions` field without any T1 filter. T2 completions therefore inflate observed capacity and understate the estimated days for remaining T1 work. The fix should record/read T1 completions consistently with the T1 candidate selection.
